chief_complaint: itchy, dry patches on the elbows and knees for a month
hpi_details: developed dry, red, and very itchy skin patches on the inner elbows and behind the knees over the last 4 weeks. Scratching makes it worse and causes the skin to bleed slightly. Has a history of asthma and hay fever, which supports an atopic background. Used a new scented body wash recently.
ideas: thinks it might be eczema flare-up or an allergy to her soap
concerns: worried it will spread to her face or leave permanent scars
expectations: wants a strong cream to stop the itching and advice on what soap to use
social_hx: student, lives in university hall, non-smoker

learning_objectives: Identify an atopic history (eczema, asthma, or allergic rhinitis) in conversation
Ask about potential triggers (scented soaps, detergents, stress, temperature changes)
Explain basic skin care rules (moisturising, avoiding scratching, using soap substitutes)
Empathise with the cosmetic concerns and physical discomfort of skin conditions
suggested_questions: Can you describe what the rash looks like and where it is located?
How itchy is it? Does it wake you up at night?
Have you started using any new soaps, cosmetics, or laundry detergents?
Do you have a personal or family history of asthma, hay fever, or skin problems?
What makes the itching better or worse?
I understand you're worried about scars. What are your main concerns about the rash?
